summary: BancPlus Corporation filed an 8-K to disclose a routine quarterly cash dividend declaration of $0.53 per share, payable September 15, 2026, to shareholders of record August 14, 2026, with an annualized rate of $2.12. No special-situation elements such as M&A, restructuring, or strategic review are present. The filing is purely a standard dividend announcement, which does not meet the criteria for a special-situation category. Therefore, this is not classified as a special situation.
